notes.title: Bee Simulator - Now available!
notes.content:
Hey Bee fans!

It's time for you to explore the world through the eyes of a bee with [b]Bee Simulator[/b]! Collect pollen, fight off wasps, interact with your fellow bees and confront multiple threats. Your entire hive is threatened the day when humans decide to chop down the tree you call home. The fate of the whole swarm is in your tiny hands! 

[previewyoutube=_vf_vjSHLoo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Ready, Steady, Fly![/h2]

Take part in a race and show your sisters who has the fastest wings in the swarm!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/914750/extras/SteamGifs_wyscig.gif?t=1605199221[/img]

[h2]I have a sting and I'm not afraid to use it![/h2]

The world of bees is not as carefree as one may think. Wasps and some of the less friendly people will take any chance to ruin your plans. Don't hesitate to use your sting to save your swarm from enemies.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/914750/extras/SteamGifs_walka.gif?t=1605199221[/img]

[h2]Dancing with the Bees[/h2]

You are the master of air acrobatics. Your sisters are eager to mirror your smooth dance moves. So perform your famous waggle dance and show them the way back to the hive.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/914750/extras/SteamGifs_taniec.gif?t=1605199221[/img]

[h2]Pollen Picker[/h2]

Explore the park thoroughly – visit even the deepest corners to look for rare plants and special flowers in order to collect the best pollen.

notes.title: Bee Simulator - Available on November 17th
notes.content:
We're delighted to announce that [b]Bee Simulator[/b] will be available on November 17th, at 10:00 am CET. To celebrate it's release on Steam here's our Accolades Trailer of the game.

[previewyoutube=puDzsHQXYQk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Ready, Steady, Fly![/h2]

Take part in a race and show your sisters who has the fastest wings in the swarm!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/914750/extras/SteamGifs_wyscig.gif?t=1605199221[/img]

[h2]I have a sting and I'm not afraid to use it![/h2]

The world of bees is not as carefree as one may think. Wasps and some of the less friendly people will take any chance to ruin your plans. Don't hesitate to use your sting to save your swarm from enemies.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/914750/extras/SteamGifs_walka.gif?t=1605199221[/img]

[h2]Dancing with the Bees[/h2]

You are the master of air acrobatics. Your sisters are eager to mirror your smooth dance moves. So perform your famous waggle dance and show them the way back to the hive.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/914750/extras/SteamGifs_taniec.gif?t=1605199221[/img]
